name: Front page replays the Eagle S and shows the live watch without signing in
description: The public landing page loads signed out with its headline, the hero replay whose moment list moves the footage, every case on file, the recorder's live figures and the eight watched regions, and the open-a-replay panel.

planSteps.description: Assert the main heading reads "Every cable cut, replayed." and the URL path is still / (no redirect to sign in)

In the hero, if the play button (data-testid hero-play) is labelled "Pause the replay", click it once so the replay is paused; then, in the moment list (data-testid hero-moments), click the row that reads "Cinia detects a fault on C-Lion1"
Assert the hero clock (data-testid hero-clock) reads 16:44 and the clicked row is marked as the current step (aria-current=step)
Assert the case list (data-testid landing-cases) holds 10 rows, each with a data-testid that starts with case-card-, and that the source card (data-testid landing-evidence) quotes Cinia

Assert the live section (data-testid recorder-status) has a data-state of recording, failing, stale, never-ran or unreachable, and that unless it is unreachable its ship count (data-testid recorder-ships) is a whole number
Assert the region list (data-testid live-regions) holds exactly 8 items, each with a data-state of heard or quiet, and that one of them reads Gulf of Finland
Assert the open-a-replay panel (data-testid open-replay) offers 10 cases in its Case list and four views: Overview, From above, Vessel and At the cut
